exadel-inc-agentic-readiness-assessment-.description: Measures every agent tool call on this machine from local session history (the user's chat logs), in any harness, finds where the time goes, and ranks fixes for slow commands, harness overhead and wasted waiting. Use when the user asks why their agents are slow, where agent run time goes, or how to cut the time agents spend waiting on tools.

Evaluates a software repository for readiness to be developed and maintained by AI coding agents, and produces an evidence-based readiness scorecard. Use when the user requests an agentic-readiness assessment, readiness scorecard, AI-readiness audit of a codebase, or recommendations for improving AI-assisted development workflows.
